witnesses.short_quote: 邻宫：相夹本宫的两个宫垣
witnesses.claim: Modern Zhongzhou-school text explicitly defines the generic adjacent-palace concept and separately defines 相夹 through stars occupying the two adjacent palaces.
Edition-bound modern Wang Tingzhi witness preserves the same basic terminology family; it is not Ming/Qing authority.
Received Fullbook tradition attests specific flank configurations and 三夹/六夹 language. It does not by itself supply the generic modern term definition 邻宫 for every rotating local origin.

internal_source_anchors.s04_definition: 本宫两侧相邻之两个宫垣。如子宫为本宫，则丑宫与亥宫即为其邻宫。
internal_source_anchors.s05_recovered_title: 中州派紫微斗数基础术语及推导技法.txt
internal_source_anchors.s05_flank_line: 两星曜位于本宫之邻宫，称为相夹
internal_source_anchors.epistemic_scope: S04/S05 are project-normalized source layers. External modern Wang Tingzhi witnesses support school attribution; internal normalization is not self-authenticating ancient authority.
